name: online-tutors
description: Lessons and tutoring held online, one to one.

languages.description: Languages a session can be held in, as BCP 47 tags.

sessions.description: How many sessions the review covers.

howDealsGo: The student pays for a block of sessions up front. The money is held until the student releases it after the last session. A missed session is made up, or its share goes back to the student. A timer to the tutor, set past the last session, pays for the sessions given if the student goes quiet.
